institution: High Point University Workman School of Dental Medicine
evidenceQuote: There is no required degree (ie Biology or Chemistry). Candidates from all majors are encouraged to apply. ... non-science majors are also encouraged to apply. ... The WSDM has learners from various backgrounds and majors. Candidates must have a minimum cumulative 3.0 undergraduate GPA to apply. A bachelor's degree/ and or anticipated bachelors (B.S. or B.A) is required before matriculation... but there is no required degree (i.e. Biology or Chemistry) or specific prerequisite coursework; the DAT is also not required.
